name: Adaptive Time Integration (Steady/Particle)
aliases: Adaptive Step Size Control for ODEs
definition: A method to keep integration error constant by lengthening or shortening the time step. It uses 11 function evaluations rather than 8, requiring a conservative factor of 0.9 for dt changes.
summary: Adaptive Time Integration dynamically adjusts particle tracing step sizes using embedded Runge-Kutta error estimates to maintain accuracy while optimizing performance in vector fields.
